description.short: Your team talks. Jira stays current.
description.full: StandSync listens to your team's standup conversation in this channel, uses Claude to understand what happened to each Jira ticket mentioned, and proposes status transitions and comments as an Adaptive Card. It stays silent on anything that is not a work update, and asks you a short question when an update is ambiguous rather than guessing. Claude only interprets and recommends — nothing is written to Jira until a human clicks Approve.
